question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date)
),
with_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as monthly_change
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as customer_name,
    AVG(mc.monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
FROM with_changes mc
JOIN customer c ON mc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE mc.monthly_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mc.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 3
